queries.name: shipments
queries.sql: SELECT id::text, order_id::text, public_reference, provider_shipment_id, provider_status, status::text, state_version, flat_rate, purpose::text, supersedes_shipment_id::text, quote_fingerprint, quote_expires_at::text, selected_postage_type, actual_purchase_total_cents, provider_cost_currency, purchased_at::text, signature_requested, destination, package_snapshot, customs_lines, rates, raw_shipment, created_at::text, updated_at::text FROM product_shipments WHERE provider='chitchats' ORDER BY id LIMIT 4097

queries.name: jobs
queries.sql: SELECT j.id::text, j.shipment_id::text, j.type::text, j.status::text, j.state_version, encode(sha256(convert_to(j.idempotency_key,'UTF8')),'hex') AS idempotency_sha256, j.attempt_count, j.operation_payload_hash, j.payload, j.outcome_unknown, (j.lease_owner IS NOT NULL) AS lease_owner_present, j.lease_expires_at::text, j.available_at::text, j.next_attempt_at::text, j.outcome_code, j.completed_at::text, j.created_at::text, j.updated_at::text FROM product_shipment_jobs j JOIN product_shipments s ON s.id=j.shipment_id WHERE s.provider='chitchats' ORDER BY j.id LIMIT 4097

queries.name: rateCache
queries.sql: SELECT id::text, zone_id, size_bucket_id, country_code, postage_type, amount_cents, currency, delivery_max_business_days, insured, tracked, computed_at::text, created_at::text, updated_at::text FROM shipping_rate_cache ORDER BY id LIMIT 4097

queries.name: events
queries.sql: SELECT e.id::text, e.shipment_id::text, encode(sha256(convert_to(e.fingerprint,'UTF8')),'hex') AS fingerprint_sha256, e.provider_status, e.normalized_status::text, e.occurred_at::text, e.created_at::text FROM product_shipment_events e JOIN product_shipments s ON s.id=e.shipment_id WHERE s.provider='chitchats' ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 4097
